#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 10000000;

class HopcroftKarp {
public:
    int m, n;
    vector<vector<int>> graph;
    vector<int> pairU, pairV, dist;
    static const int NIL = 0;

    HopcroftKarp(int m_, int n_, vector<vector<int>>& graph_) : m(m_), n(n_), graph(graph_) {
        pairU.assign(m + 1, NIL);
        pairV.assign(n + 1, NIL);
        dist.assign(m + 1, 0);
    }

    int maxMatching() {
        fill(pairU.begin(), pairU.end(), NIL);
        fill(pairV.begin(), pairV.end(), NIL);
        int res = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                if (pairU[i] == NIL && dfs(i)) res++;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

private:
    bool bfs() {
        queue<int> q;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            if (pairU[i] == NIL) {
                q.push(i);
                dist[i] = 0;
            } else {
                dist[i] = INF;
            }
        }
        dist[NIL] = INF;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (dist[u] < dist[NIL]) {
                for (int v : graph[u]) {
                    if (dist[pairV[v]] == INF) {
                        q.push(pairV[v]);
                        dist[pairV[v]] = dist[u] + 2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[NIL] < INF;
    }

    bool dfs(int u) {
        if (u == NIL) return true;
        for (int v : graph[u]) {
            if (dist[pairV[v]] == dist[u] + 2) {
                if (dfs(pairV[v])) {
                    pairV[v] = u;
                    pairU[u] = v;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        dist[u] = INF;
        return false;
    }
};

class Solver {
public:
    int n, m;

    void solve() {
        ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);

        long long answer = 0;

        cin >> n >> m;

        if (n > 100) {
            int rem = (n - 100) % 6;
            long long q = (n - 100) / 6;
            answer += q * 6LL * m;
            n = 100 + rem;
        }

        if (m > 100) {
            int rem = (m - 100) % 6;
            long long q = (m - 100) / 6;
            answer += q * 6LL * n;
            m = 100 + rem;
        }

        vector<vector<int>> id(n + 1, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
        int even = 1, odd = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if (((i + j) & 1) == 0) id[i][j] = even++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if (((i + j) & 1) != 0) id[i][j] = odd++;
            }
        }

        int oddCount = odd - 1;
        int evenCount = even - 1;

        vector<vector<int>> graph(oddCount + 1);

        auto addEdge = [&](int i, int j, int s, int t) {
            if (s <= 0 || t <= 0 || s > n || t > m) return;
            graph[id[i][j]].push_back(id[s][t]);
        };

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if (((i + j) & 1) != 0) {
                    addEdge(i, j, i - 3, j);
                    addEdge(i, j, i - 2, j - 1);
                    addEdge(i, j, i - 2, j + 1);
                    addEdge(i, j, i, j - 3);
                    addEdge(i, j, i - 1, j - 2);
                    addEdge(i, j, i + 1, j - 2);
                    addEdge(i, j, i, j + 3);
                    addEdge(i, j, i - 1, j + 2);
                    addEdge(i, j, i + 1, j + 2);
                    addEdge(i, j, i + 3, j);
                    addEdge(i, j, i + 2, j - 1);
                    addEdge(i, j, i + 2, j + 1);
                }
            }
        }

        HopcroftKarp hk(oddCount, evenCount, graph);
        answer += 2LL * hk.maxMatching();
        cout << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    Solver solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
